prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity visual-direction comp for a desktop ecommerce homepage
Primary request: Design the category-standard version of the Grădina Kasper homepage, executed impeccably but intentionally conventional. This is a working website interface, not a poster or a photograph with text.
Input images: Home.png is a binding reference for rounded friendly typography, green color usage, and playful restraint; how-it-works.png contributes only the three-step idea, not its layout; footer.png is the existing footer identity; random-site.png contributes only catalogue readability and spacious product presentation.
Structure: landscape desktop frame around 1536×1024. A compact white navigation with the real Grădina Kasper logo, links Acasă / Produsele noastre / Despre Noi / Știai Că, cart, Conectare, Creează cont. Below it, a conventional polished split hero: large rounded greenhouse photograph on the right and clear offer on the left. Under the hero, begin a tidy featured-box card and a quiet trust/how-it-works strip so enough of the surface is visible to prove the system.
Exact visible Romanian text: “Din grădina noastră. Direct pe masa ta. Proaspăt din Brașov.”; “Creștem legume netratate, într-o grădină vie, și ți le aducem proaspete la tine acasă!”; “Cutia Family”; “150 RON”; “4–5 kg”; “Următoarea livrare: 28.09.2026”; primary CTA “Adaugă în coș”; secondary CTA “Vezi toate cele 18 cutii”.
Style/medium: polished farm-to-table ecommerce UI, friendly rounded sans typography, large rounded product cards, generous white space, clear hierarchy.
Color palette: white #FFFFFF, greenhouse green #0B5A3C, pale green #DFF1C5, neutral #F1F1EC, very small tomato accent only where useful.
Constraints: immediately communicate that Grădina Kasper sells locally grown vegetable boxes; friendly and accessible, not luxury; mature playfulness; core text and controls must read as semantic web UI; no invented testimonials, awards, certifications, discounts, or extra claims.
Avoid: generic ShadCN card grid, glassmorphism, gradients, purple, excessive floating pills, rustic burlap clichés, hyper-luxury styling, poster-like composition, rasterized paragraphs, mobile frame.
